re_001.name: An element exists once
re_001.text: An element shall exist once, in the containment tree; diagrams hold symbols that point at it. Rename it and every diagram, table and matrix follows.

re_006.name: Structure is never drawn twice
re_006.text: Composition, reference and containment shall be derived from part properties, reference properties and ownership, never stored as edges.

re_007.name: The core runs without a DOM
re_007.text: model/ and io/ shall not touch the DOM, so the tests — and a later command-line tool — run them under Node.

re_005.name: Stable check codes
re_005.text: Every check shall carry a stable code, listed in RULES and printed by Help.

re_003.name: Repair, or refuse with a reason
re_003.text: Loading shall repair what it can and report it, and refuse what it cannot with a sentence that says why.

re_002.name: An unsaved edit is never overwritten
re_002.text: A newer version from another device shall replace the open model only while nothing here is unsaved; otherwise both timestamps are shown and the person asked.

re_004.name: Round-trip through XMI
re_004.text: A file this app wrote shall round-trip losslessly through XMI; what another tool wrote with no counterpart here shall be counted, not silently lost.
